iti86:2.1: (Tik. IV.) Dhammānudhammapaṭipannassa bhikkhuno ayam-anudhammo hoti, veyyākaraṇāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno 'yan-ti, bhāsamāno dhammaññeva bhāsati no adhammaṃ, vitakkayamāno vā dhammavitakkaññeva vitakketi no adhammavitakkaṃ, tad-ubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno ti. Dhammārāmo dhammarato dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ | dhammaṃ
iti86:4.1: Caraṃ vā yadi vā tiṭṭhaṃ nisinno udavā sayaṃ | ajjhattaṃ samayaṃ cittaṃ santim-evādhigacchatīti ||7||
